_doc: The question sign-out asks first (shared/src/sign-out.ts, Android :core SignOut.kt). `warning`: signOutWarning(changes, drafts), where changes are label changes on threads plus label and filter edits queued on the device, and drafts are drafts or sends not yet in Gmail and thrown-away drafts whose delete hasn't reached it; null signs out at once.

warning.name: one change
warning.expect: 1 change hasn't synced yet. Signing out deletes it from this device.

warning.name: changes
warning.expect: 3 changes haven't synced yet. Signing out deletes them from this device.

warning.name: one draft
warning.expect: 1 draft hasn't synced yet. Signing out deletes it from this device.

warning.name: drafts
warning.expect: 2 drafts haven't synced yet. Signing out deletes them from this device.

warning.name: both
warning.expect: 2 changes and 1 draft haven't synced yet. Signing out deletes them from this device.

warning.name: one of each
warning.expect: 1 change and 1 draft haven't synced yet. Signing out deletes them from this device.
